entryPoints: context menu on empty palette background

systemIcon.visibleSession: palette visible, including owned menus and calibration/settings views
systemIcon.hiddenPalette: hide icon under conditional mode; app and hotkey remain running
systemIcon.recovery: ordinary app launch shows the calculator even if the icon is hidden; production single-instance activation belongs to architecture

protected: standard copy with existing contextual result-copy rules
shortcuts.conflict: keep previous working assignment; app launch remains an entry point when a conditional tray/menu-bar icon is hidden; a visible palette session exposes its icon/menu

modeTransitions.expand: place quick draft in the first line of a new sheet
modeTransitions.returnToQuick: preserve the sheet and restore the preceding quick draft

autostart.actualOsPermission: respect and report actual system registration/permission; do not assume the requested setting succeeded

appearance.specificFontColorsAndOpacity: Light-sheet appearance accepted in round 33. The complete revised round 34 screens and neutral graphite-black Dark+ palette are accepted; exact adapted tokens are in workspace.json.

calibration.scope: calculator content typography and geometry, shared across quick input, history and other working surfaces; settings controls keep a legible minimum size
calibration.persistedDefault: used on subsequent launches; settings are portable only through the existing explicit settings-import choice
calibration.factoryDefaultChange: The compact layout previously labelled 70% is now the 100% baseline, without enlarging the interface.

legacyPrototypeProfileMigration.percentage: old percent * 100 / 70, rounded to the nearest whole percent to match the control step
legacyPrototypeProfileMigration.rangeRationale: 50–300 accommodates the entire previously saved 50–200 range after rebasing

localization.initialLocale: system language if its translation is available, otherwise en
localization.missingLocale: English only; do not activate an unavailable local notation dictionary
localization.missingMessage: English source text only for that message
localization.switch: immediate interface update; recognized built-in semantic symbols adapt
localization.unrecognizedRemainder: leave visible and apply ordinary input diagnostics; do not guess a translation
localization.inputNotations: Latin baseline plus only the resolved active interface locale

completion.midTokenTab: replace the whole current identifier, not just the prefix before the caret
completion.functionParentheses: preserve existing parentheses and arguments; add a pair only when absent
fullDescription: F1 for selected suggestion; general help otherwise
completion.insufficientSpace: fewer visible rows with scrolling and stationary input
completion.extremeScreenEdge: accepted variant A: move only the suggestion list; preserve the visible text, caret, editor viewport and main window

edgePlacement.ordinaryPlacement: below the current word, aligned with its beginning
edgePlacement.atLeastOneCompleteRowBelow: remain below with up to seven complete visible rows and scrolling for the rest
edgePlacement.noCompleteRowBelow: open above; this is the only condition for the bottom-edge exception
edgePlacement.insufficientWidthOnRight: shift only the list left as needed to fit the work area
edgePlacement.verification: accepted from a bounded WPF layout comparison; real native popup placement, scaled multi-monitor layouts, focus, IME and assistive technology remain to be verified

accessibility.diagnostic: brief, near expression, no input displacement

verificationOutstanding: verification of definition editor and settings states beyond the accepted prototype fixtures
native implementation of accepted completion edge placement and scaled layouts
